description: lifecycle.rs Command::Ihave is not intercepted before dispatch(). dispatch() falls through to Response::unknown_command() (500). RFC 3977 §6.3.2 requires IHAVE to either accept (335 + read dot-terminated body) or reject (435/436/437). If a transit peer sends 'IHAVE <msgid>\r\n' followed by a dot-terminated article body, the server responds 500 but never reads the body bytes, leaving the connection with unread article data. The next command read will see the article body as if it were a command — persistent connection desync. For a busy transit peer that pipelines IHAVE submissions this corrupts the entire session.
title: IHAVE command reads no article body — connection desync
